test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

A sailor was __________through the high tides.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence describes an action performed by **a sailor.**
 
• The word that fits correctly in the context of the sentence is 'sailing'.
 
• The other options **'swelling', 'selling', and 'ceiling'** do not fit the context of the sentence.

Hence, the correct statement is: ***A sailor was sailing__ through the high tides*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The word **'sailing'** is a** present participle form of the verb 'sail' which means to travel on water in a boat or ship**.
 
• The verb **'swelling'** means to become larger or rounder in size, typically as a result of an accumulation of fluid.
 
• The verb **'selling' **means to exchange a commodity for money.
 
• The noun **'ceiling'** refers to the upper interior surface of a room.
